originalTitle: Here’s Why SCHD is Beating the S&P 500 in 2026 YTD
summary: Investors who wrote off dividend ETFs as relics of a pre-AI market are quietly reversing course in 2026, and the reasons behind SCHD's sudden surge reveal something important about how factor tilts and sector bets can quietly build or destroy a portfolio's edge.
content:
Retail investors never cease to amuse me with their tendency to abandon investment strategies when they’re out of favor, only to pile back into them once performance improves. Case in point is the Schwab U.S. Dividend Equity ETF (SCHD) .

Throughout much of 2024 and 2025, I saw countless posts on Reddit dismissing SCHD as a stale dividend fund while artificial intelligence (AI) stocks propelled the S&P 500 and Nasdaq-100 to new highs. The narrative was that dividend investing had become obsolete in a market dominated by mega-cap technology.

Fast forward to 2026, and the script has flipped. As of July 21, 2026, SCHD has delivered a 21.62% year-to-date total return, assuming dividends are reinvested. By comparison, the Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) has gained just 10.36%, less than half as much. Naturally, investors are paying attention again.

So today, I want to do two things. For investors who are new to SCHD, we’ll review what makes it one of the most distinctive dividend ETFs on the market. For longtime SCHD holders, we’ll dig into the factor and sector tilts that have helped propel the fund ahead of the S&P 500 so far this year.

SCHD tracks the Dow Jones U.S. Dividend 100 Index while charging an exceptionally low 0.06% expense ratio. The index construction is more sophisticated than simply selecting the highest-yielding stocks. The result is a portfolio that currently offers a 3.33% 30-day SEC yield while emphasizing financially healthy companies capable of sustaining and growing their dividends.

It begins by identifying companies that have maintained at least 10 consecutive years of dividend payments. Those companies are then evaluated using a composite score based on free cash flow to total debt, return on equity, dividend yield, and five-year dividend growth. The 100 highest-ranked companies become the portfolio, with quarterly rebalancing and an annual reconstitution.

One characteristic investors sometimes overlook is that SCHD actually has fairly high turnover. As of the June annual reconstitution, 42.28% of the holdings changed. Ordinarily, that amount of trading could generate taxable capital gains. Fortunately, because SCHD is structured as an ETF, the in-kind creation and redemption process makes capital gains distributions rare.

In my view, there are two primary reasons SCHD has outperformed both VOO and the broader S&P 500 so far in 2026. The first is the resurgence of the value factor. Alongside dividend ETFs, value-oriented strategies have broadly outperformed the market this year.

That’s not particularly surprising because many dividend ETFs are essentially value funds in disguise. SCHD fits that description well. The portfolio currently trades at a forward price-to-earnings ratio of 19.07 times, noticeably below VOO, while still maintaining an impressive 26.54% return on equity. Whenever large-cap value stocks outperform growth stocks, SCHD naturally benefits.

The second driver has been sector allocation. Following its most recent annual reconstitution, SCHD entered 2026 with substantial overweights in consumer staples (15.5%), energy (12.5%), and healthcare (11.7%) relative to the S&P 500.

While consumer staples and healthcare have delivered more modest returns, energy has been one of the market’s strongest sectors following supply disruptions stemming from the Strait of Hormuz during the U.S.-Israel-Iran conflict. That overweight has provided a meaningful boost to SCHD’s overall performance.

Going forward, however, investors should remain focused on the process rather than the recent performance. SCHD’s holdings change every year based on its screening methodology, so next year’s portfolio won’t necessarily look like today’s. Whether the ETF continues outperforming will depend on how its factor exposures and sector allocations evolve after future reconstitutions.

More importantly, strategies like SCHD only work if investors stick with them through multiple market cycles. The same value and sector tilts driving today’s outperformance can just as easily become headwinds in another environment. As always, the key is staying the course rather than chasing whichever strategy happens to be leading this year.

chineseTitle: 这就是 SCHD 在 2026 年年初至今击败标准普尔 500 指数的原因
chineseSummary: 那些将股息 ETF 视为前人工智能市场遗物的投资者将在 2026 年悄然扭转方向，SCHD 突然飙升背后的原因揭示了一些重要因素，即因子倾斜和行业押注如何悄然建立或摧毁投资组合的优势。
chineseContent:
散户投资者总是在投资策略失宠时放弃投资策略，而一旦业绩改善，他们就会重新投入投资策略，这让我觉得很有趣。典型的例子是嘉信理财美国股息股票 ETF (SCHD)。

在 2024 年和 2025 年的大部分时间里，我在 Reddit 上看到无数帖子，将 SCHD 斥为过时的股息基金，而人工智能 (AI) 股票则推动标准普尔 500 指数和纳斯达克 100 指数创下新高。人们的说法是，在由大型科技公司主导的市场中，股息投资已经过时。

快进到 2026 年，剧本发生了翻转。截至 2026 年 7 月 21 日，假设股息进行再投资，SCHD 的年初至今总回报率为 21.62%。相比之下，Vanguard S&P 500 ETF (VOO) 的涨幅仅为 10.36%，不到一半。自然，投资者再次关注。

所以今天我想做两件事。对于刚接触 SCHD 的投资者，我们将回顾一下是什么使它成为市场上最独特的股息 ETF 之一。对于 SCHD 的长期持有者，我们将深入探讨今年迄今为止帮助该基金领先于标准普尔 500 指数的因素和行业倾斜。

SCHD 追踪道琼斯美国股息 100 指数，同时收取极低的 0.06% 费用率。该指数的构建比简单地选择收益最高的股票更为复杂。其结果是，目前的投资组合 30 天 SEC 收益率为 3.33%，同时强调财务状况良好、能够维持和增加股息的公司。

首先确定至少连续 10 年维持股息支付的公司。然后使用基于自由现金流与总债务、股本回报率、股息收益率和五年股息增长的综合评分来评估这些公司。排名最高的 100 家公司成为投资组合，并进行季度再平衡和年度重组。

投资者有时会忽视的一个特征是，SCHD 实际上具有相当高的换手率。截至6月年度重组，42.28%的持股发生变化。通常情况下，这一数额的交易可以产生应税资本利得。幸运的是，由于 SCHD 的结构为 ETF，实物创建和赎回过程使得资本收益分配很少见。

在我看来，SCHD 在 2026 年迄今为止表现优于 VOO 和更广泛的标准普尔 500 指数有两个主要原因。第一个是价值因素的复苏。除了股息 ETF 之外，今年以价值为导向的策略也普遍跑赢了市场。

这并不特别令人惊讶，因为许多股息 ETF 本质上是变相的价值基金。 SCHD 很符合这个描述。该投资组合目前的远期市盈率为 19.07 倍，明显低于 VOO，同时仍保持令人印象深刻的 26.54% 股本回报率。每当大盘价值股跑赢成长股时，SCHD 自然会受益。

第二个驱动因素是行业分配。经过最近的年度重组后，SCHD 进入 2026 年，相对于标准普尔 500 指数，消费品指数 (15.5%)、能源 (12.5%) 和医疗保健 (11.7%) 大幅增持。

尽管必需消费品和医疗保健的回报率较为温和，但在美以伊朗冲突期间霍尔木兹海峡造成供应中断后，能源一直是市场最强劲的板块之一。这种增持对 SCHD 的整体业绩产生了有意义的推动。

然而，展望未来，投资者应继续关注这一过程，而不是最近的表现。 SCHD 的持股每年都会根据其筛选方法而变化，因此明年的投资组合不一定会像今天的那样。 ETF 能否继续跑赢大市将取决于未来重组后其要素敞口和行业配置的演变。

更重要的是，只有当投资者在多个市场周期中坚持使用 SCHD 等策略时，它们才会发挥作用。同样的价值和行业倾斜推动了今天的优异表现，在另一个环境中也很容易成为阻力。与往常一样，关键是坚持到底，而不是追逐今年恰好领先的策略。
